evidenceBoundary: The package suite builds the real Video Studio UI and sidecar, with each run in an isolated temporary RYU_DIR. It covers local tab routing, project persistence, vector edits, local OBJ/glTF parsing, recipe/layout edits, pointer/keyboard timeline edits, and local FFmpeg export. No stock provider, model, media generation, Spaces service, remote media, or device surface is invoked. The export case accepts a completed MP4 when the host has libass, or asserts the user-visible subtitles/libass error and Retry state when the host FFmpeg lacks that filter. Source row relocation only; no new current-source execution or behavioral closure is claimed by this map update. W5-I2 rows (each names its own spec) come from the evidence specs that the default config now runs; they drive the real UI and sidecar in a local browser host with no Ryu chat, media or model bridge, so Ask agent and AI gap fill are proven only in their unavailable states.

assertions.testTitle: all Video Studio category tabs open their real panels
assertions.assertionName: Every category tab opens its corresponding visible editor panel.

assertions.testTitle: NumberField, keyboard, and pointer timeline edits save and read back
assertions.assertionName: Timeline NumberField reverts invalid expressions, clamps out-of-range values, evaluates typed arithmetic, and saves the valid timeline start.

assertions.testTitle: Vector graphics color and bounded number inputs persist and update preview
assertions.assertionName: The fill color updates the rendered triangle and reads back from the saved project.

assertions.testTitle: Vector graphics color and bounded number inputs persist and update preview
assertions.assertionName: Out-of-range graphic numbers reset and valid values persist on blur.

assertions.testTitle: production recipe and layout save an editable project and render it locally
assertions.assertionName: Selecting a non-default layout places saved clips into the expected grid slots.

assertions.testTitle: mesh import rejects external glTF buffers and recovers with a local OBJ
assertions.assertionName: External glTF buffers are rejected without a request and a valid local OBJ reads back.
assertions.assertionMarker: External glTF buffers are not accepted.

assertions.testTitle: production recipe and layout save an editable project and render it locally
assertions.assertionName: The selected recipe sends the exact assets, title, format, and shot-duration payload.

assertions.testTitle: NumberField, keyboard, and pointer timeline edits save and read back
assertions.assertionName: Alt-arrow movement and pointer move/trim gestures persist their timeline readback.
